intent: Validate injected demand before atomic reservation without granting authority
expected_result: Eligible-for-reservation, refused or unknown with source-bound explicit inputs

outputs.contract: Eligible-for-reservation, refused or unknown with source-bound explicit inputs

acceptance.check: All worker roles consume one injected pool; exact boundary and nested linked demand validate
Unknown or hostile input never becomes zero usage, authority, reservation or a second unmetered pool

guards: Own only listed paths; no foreign registry, process, credential or installation changes
No native PASS from compiler/fake acceptance; bind reports to candidate SHA
One heavy check slot; do not duplicate installs

resume.next: Read plan and R1 boundary; inspect local module, independently test its refusal cases
resume.after_change: Bind source digest and verdict; retain no-runtime-enforcement limitation
